flows.name: Redstone Tablet Setup
flows.description: Actions for provisioning and maintaining Peloton Redstone design review tablets

steps.title: Install Apps
steps.description: Choose one or more APK files to install on the connected tablet.

steps.title: Take Screenshot
steps.description: Capture the tablet's current screen and save it to your Desktop.

commands.label: Capture screen
commands.shell: adb exec-out screencap -p > "$HOME/Desktop/redstone-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).png" && echo "Screenshot saved to $HOME/Desktop/"

steps.title: Display Image
steps.description: Choose an image file to push to the tablet and open on its screen.

steps.title: Switch Hardware
steps.description: Set the tablet's simulated hardware platform, then reboot.

options.title: Bike
options.shell:
echo "Setting hardware type to Titan..."
adb shell settings put global peloton_platform titan
adb shell am broadcast -a com.onepeloton.activity.SET_HARDWARE --es "hardware_type" "titan"
adb shell touch /sdcard/.HomeInstallerDone
adb shell rm -rf /sdcard/.enablePrismSimulator
adb shell rm -rf /sdcard/.enableAuroraSimulator
echo "Rebooting..."
adb reboot
echo "Bike hardware ready."
adb shell am broadcast -a onepeloton.intent.action.AUTOMATION_FAKE_DATA --es onepeloton.intent.extra.PLATFORM prism --ei onepeloton.intent.extra.FAKE_DATA_STATE 0

options.title: Row
options.shell:
echo "Setting hardware type to Row..."
adb shell settings put global peloton_platform caesar
adb shell am broadcast -a com.onepeloton.activity.SET_HARDWARE --es "hardware_type" "caesar"
adb shell touch /sdcard/.HomeInstallerDone
adb shell rm -rf /sdcard/.enablePrismSimulator
adb shell rm -rf /sdcard/.enableAuroraSimulator
echo "Rebooting..."
adb reboot
echo "Row hardware ready."

options.title: Tread
options.shell:
echo "Setting hardware type to Tread..."
adb shell settings put global peloton_platform prism
adb shell am broadcast -a com.onepeloton.activity.SET_HARDWARE --es "hardware_type" "prism"
adb shell touch /sdcard/.HomeInstallerDone
adb shell touch /sdcard/.enablePrismSimulator
echo "Rebooting..."
adb reboot
echo "Tread hardware ready."

options.title: Tread+
options.shell:
echo "Setting hardware type to Tread..."
adb shell settings put global peloton_platform aurora
adb shell am broadcast -a com.onepeloton.activity.SET_HARDWARE --es "hardware_type" "aurora"
adb shell touch /sdcard/.HomeInstallerDone
adb shell touch /sdcard/.enableAuroraSimulator
echo "Rebooting..."
adb reboot
echo "Tread hardware ready."

steps.title: Remove PIN Indicator
steps.description: Disable the sensor-state PIN indicator overlays on the tablet.

steps.title: Configure Display
steps.description: Set display density and font scale optimized for design review, and reduce animations for cleaner screenshots.

commands.label: Set font scale to 1.0
commands.shell: adb shell settings put system font_scale 1.0

commands.label: Reduce animations
commands.shell: adb shell settings put global window_animation_scale 0.5 && adb shell settings put global transition_animation_scale 0.5 && adb shell settings put global animator_duration_scale 0.5

steps.title: Debug Overlays
steps.description: Toggle layout bounds and pointer location overlays useful for design QA.

commands.label: Enable pointer location
commands.shell: adb shell settings put system pointer_location 1

commands.label: Refresh screen to apply overlays
commands.shell: adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP && sleep 0.5 && adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP

offCommands.label: Disable pointer location
offCommands.shell: adb shell settings put system pointer_location 0

offCommands.label: Refresh screen to apply
offCommands.shell: adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP && sleep 0.5 && adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP

steps.title: Reset Display
steps.description: Restore the tablet's default display density, font scale, and animation speeds.
steps.confirmMessage: This will revert the tablet's display density, font scale, and animation speeds to their defaults.

commands.label: Reset font scale
commands.shell: adb shell settings put system font_scale 1.0

commands.label: Restore animations
commands.shell: adb shell settings put global window_animation_scale 1.0 && adb shell settings put global transition_animation_scale 1.0 && adb shell settings put global animator_duration_scale 1.0

steps.title: Push Design Config
steps.description: Create the Redstone design review configuration directory on the tablet.
steps.confirmMessage: This will create the Redstone design review configuration directory on the connected tablet.
